name: Motorcycle Simulator Nevada
summary:
Ride Las Vegas from the seat - solo or with your friends.

53 KM ROUND LAS VEGAS
I-15 north up the Strip past Allegiant Stadium, the Luxor, the High Roller, the Sphere and the STRAT, through the Spaghetti Bowl downtown, I-11 south-east to Henderson under Frenchman Mountain, and the I-215 Beltway round Harry Reid airport. Real roads, real desert, real skyline.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room or opens yours; Private Room gives you a 4-digit code for your friend
